properties.ValidationRuleDescription: A holon has at most one direct Extends parent.
A descriptor Extends lineage must be acyclic.
A parented descriptor lineage must terminate at TypeDescriptor.
TypeDescriptor is the unique root of the descriptor hierarchy.
Versioned schema dependency relationships must be acyclic.
Every cross-schema reference must have a direct schema dependency declaration.
Core contract, behavior, and operator accumulator relationships must declare Additive inheritance.
Instance TypeKind anchor designation is local and singular.
Every Instance TypeKind anchor must be abstract.
TypeDescriptor is the only descriptor root that lacks an Instance TypeKind anchor.
Every describing type must belong to the required describing category.
Descriptor holons, and only descriptor holons, must use meta-type describers.
A descriptor must not redundantly redeclare an inherited member.
Effective semantic member names must be unique within each namespace.
Every effective member definition must be well formed.
Every effective contract member must have the required instance kind.
A ValueType subtype must not relax a value constraint inherited through its Extends lineage.
Only required properties may declare defaults.
Every declared default value must conform to its effective value definition.
Inverse relationship endpoints must correspond to declared relationship endpoints.
Both relationship directions must declare valid deletion semantics.
Every holon type must resolve exactly one effective instance key rule.
The selected key rule target must be compatible with and executable for the descriptor.
The keyless root must be explicit and key-rule inheritance must use Override semantics.
Enum member names must be unique within each effective enum definition.
Minimum enforcement for abstract descriptors is member-specific.
Every declared property name must bind uniquely to a property descriptor admitted by the effective contract.
Relationship occurrences must be grouped by resolved relationship descriptor identity.
Every unbound relationship must be permitted by the effective additional-relationship policy.
A keyless holon must carry no semantic key.
A keyed new holon must carry exactly the computed semantic key.
A holon must have exactly one describing descriptor before descriptor-aware validation can continue.
A runtime holon must be described by a concrete descriptor that can describe instances.
Every unbound property must be permitted by the effective additional-property policy.
A property declared required by the effective descriptor contract must be present.
A populated property value must conform to the selected ValueType descriptor.
A value governed by a StringValueType descriptor must use the string BaseValue representation.

properties.SemanticAuthority: String constraint semantics; Unicode extended grapheme cluster counting
properties.ValidationRuleDescription: A string value must satisfy the min and max length constraints declared by its StringValueType descriptor.
A value governed by an IntegerValueType descriptor must use the integer BaseValue representation.
An integer value must satisfy the min and max constraints declared by its IntegerValueType descriptor.
A value governed by a BooleanValueType descriptor must use the boolean BaseValue representation.
A value governed by an EnumValueType descriptor must use the enum BaseValue representation.
An enum value token must match one of the effective enum variants admitted by the EnumValueType descriptor.
Enum token changes must never rewrite or alias persisted enum values.
A value governed by a BytesValueType descriptor must use the bytes BaseValue representation.
A bytes value must satisfy the min and max length constraints declared by its BytesValueType descriptor.
A populated relationship name must bind uniquely to a relationship descriptor admitted by the effective contract.
A relationship occurrence endpoint must be compatible with the effective source and target descriptors.
A relationship occurrence collection must honor ordering and duplicate policies declared by the relationship descriptor.
A relationship occurrence set must satisfy descriptor cardinality where the validation context supplies the required transaction or graph snapshot.
Declared and inverse relationship descriptor pairing must be bijective.
